class Panel:
    def __init__(self):
        self.elements = ['<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"420mm\" height=\"297mm\" viewBox=\"0 0 420 297\">']

    def rect(self, x, y, width, height, fill, radius=0):
        self.elements.append(f'<rect x=\"{x}\" y=\"{y}\" width=\"{width}\" height=\"{height}\" fill=\"{fill}\" rx=\"{radius}\"/>')

    def line(self, x1, y1, x2, y2, stroke=rule, width=.42):
        self.elements.append(f'<path d=\"M {x1} {y1} L {x2} {y2}\" stroke=\"{stroke}\" stroke-width=\"{width}\"/>')

    def circle(self, x, y, radius, fill, stroke='none', width=.5):
        self.elements.append(f'<circle cx=\"{x}\" cy=\"{y}\" r=\"{radius}\" fill=\"{fill}\" stroke=\"{stroke}\" stroke-width=\"{width}\"/>')

    def text(self, x, y, content, size, color=ink, *, bold=False, serif=False, spacing=0):
        family = 'Georgia, serif' if serif else 'Trebuchet MS, sans-serif'
        weight = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
        self.elements.append(f'<text x=\"{x}\" y=\"{y}\" fill=\"{color}\" font-family=\"{family}\" font-size=\"{size}\" font-weight=\"{weight}\" letter-spacing=\"{spacing}\">{escape(content)}</text>')

    def save(self, filename):
        (work / filename).write_text('\\n'.join(self.elements + ['</svg>']))
